counterBadgeChars.description: Small read-only badge above the prompt box or under a reply: the number first, as short as the language allows. {count} is the formatted number of characters (line breaks excluded); keep {count} exactly as written

counterBadgeCharsOne.description: The same badge as counterBadgeChars when the language treats {count} as singular (English: exactly 1). Use the singular noun; where the language has no singular form, repeat counterBadgeChars. Keep {count} exactly as written

counterBadgeWords.description: Small read-only badge above the prompt box or under a reply: the number first, as short as the language allows. {count} is the formatted number of words (each Chinese, Japanese or Korean character counts as one word); keep {count} exactly as written

counterBadgeWordsOne.description: The same badge as counterBadgeWords when the language treats {count} as singular (English: exactly 1). Use the singular noun; where the language has no singular form, repeat counterBadgeWords. Keep {count} exactly as written

counterBadgeCjkChars.description: Small read-only badge above the prompt box or under a reply: the number first, as short as the language allows. {count} is the formatted number of Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters only; keep {count} exactly as written

counterBadgeCjkCharsOne.description: The same badge as counterBadgeCjkChars when the language treats {count} as singular (English: exactly 1). Use the singular noun; where the language has no singular form, repeat counterBadgeCjkChars. Keep {count} exactly as written

counterBadgeLines.description: Small read-only badge above the prompt box or under a reply: the number first, as short as the language allows. {count} is the formatted number of lines; keep {count} exactly as written

counterBadgeLinesOne.description: The same badge as counterBadgeLines when the language treats {count} as singular (English: exactly 1). Use the singular noun; where the language has no singular form, repeat counterBadgeLines. Keep {count} exactly as written
